cited.quote: an announcement was made on the floor of the Assembly to form an International Center at vadalur
Tender has been approved and the works are in progress.

rationale: C3 (policy note) reports an estimate of Rs.99.90 crore for the International Center at Vadalur, a tender approved and works in progress. This is an official step, but the centre is not reported as complete or operational.

cited.quote: Rs.5.71 crore under General category and an amount of Rs.5.5 crore under Special Component Plan (SCP) category

rationale: C2 and C4 mention Special Component Plan funds within a solar pump scheme, and C5 describes general monitoring. None is a new guideline or order to strictly enforce the Special Component Plan.

cited.quote: The detailed project reports for second phase and third phase are under preparation.

rationale: C1 covers the Cauvery-Gundar link canal, a different and broader river link; its later phases only have project reports under preparation. No extract concerns a Therkaaru-Gundaaru link in Virudhunagar. Related activity only.

cited.quote: the Government has been focusing on the development of satellite townships in semi-urban areas
Declaration of Salem Urban Planning Area under clause (48) of section 2

rationale: C1 describes TNHB satellite townships (Chennai, Madurai) with no dated start. C4 and C5 are GOs declaring Salem and Madurai urban planning areas, and C3 budgets plans for Coimbatore and Madurai suburbs. These are planning steps, not suburbs with modern amenities.

cited.quote: installation of 86 Automatic Rain gauges, 14 Automatic Weather Stations, 149 Automatic Water Level Recorders

rationale: C1 describes flood forecasting and early warning systems, which are related but are not 24-hour special control centres for estuarine flooding. C4 is a JICA flood master plan GO and C2, C3 and C5 are on other subjects. No official step for the promised centres.

cited.quote: identifying all illiterates through a comprehensive survey in all Rural and Urban areas of the State

rationale: C1 and C2 report adult literacy programmes and a statewide survey, but show no formation of district-level committees for literacy surveys and classes. C5 is a jail committee and C4 an education policy committee, both unrelated.

cited.quote: Preparation of feasibility study report (FSR) for establishing MRTS in Madurai, Salem, Trichy and Tirunelveli
The feasibility studies are under progress.

rationale: C1 is a GO of 2021-08-09 approving a feasibility study for MRTS in the four cities, and C2 reports the studies under progress. This is a preparatory official step; no MRTS is introduced.
C1 to C5 are health insurance GOs listing private network hospitals and their specialities. None addresses equipping district government hospitals to perform heart surgeries.

cited.quote: some of the tenements constructed in the past are in dilapidated condition, posing risk to the lives

rationale: C4 (GO of 2022-01-25) and C1 cover reconstruction of dilapidated slum board tenements for earlier occupants generally. No extract mentions fishermen or allotting new houses to them, so it is a broader scheme for a different beneficiary group.

cited.quote: Rs.25,000 for non-graduates and Rs.50,000 for degree / diploma holders is given along with 8 gram
beneficiaries are given 8 gram gold coin along with cash assistance of Rs.50,000/- for the graduates and diploma holders

rationale: C3 (2021) and C2 (2025-26) both show Rs.50,000 for degree and diploma holders with an 8 gram gold coin. The amount was not raised to Rs.60,000. C4 and C5 replace one marriage scheme with an education scheme.

cited.quote: A suitable land for this project is being finalised and soon after, a detailed project report will be prepared.

rationale: C2 describes a planned Global Sports City in Chennai with academies and hostels, but land is still being finalised and the project report is yet to be prepared. C1 lists other facilities. No GO, tender or sanction for a Games Village.

cited.quote: Manual for Issuance and Verification of Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes Community Certificates

rationale: C1 and C2 are the 2023 GO issuing a general SC/ST certificate manual. No extract mentions Hindu Kanikkar or Irular communities, so it is a broader step not shown to cover these groups. C3, C4 and C5 are audit and scrutiny material.

cited.quote: life convict prisoners would be released on humanitarian grounds as goodwill gesture

rationale: C1 to C3 report general premature release guidelines for life convicts (GO 488 of 2021-11-15). None mentions the 7 convicts, Perarivalan, or action for their release. This is a broader remission scheme for a different group.

cited.quote: the entire quantity of milk is procured by district milk unions

rationale: C1 to C5 describe Aavin marketing, sales and exports. C2 notes that district unions procure milk, but no extract shows any step to regularise procurement for milk distribution in government schools.

cited.quote: A special syllabus has been developed and implemented to teach and train the Government school students
students are trained in fine arts like drama, music, dance and folk arts

rationale: C4 (policy note) says a special syllabus under Kalaiarangam is implemented for class 6-9 government school students, covering folk arts, with funds in the 2024-25 academic year. The start date is not stated, so the year is the earliest the extract supports.

cited.quote: TVA is working to include all Tamil characters, ancient fractions, symbols, and vattezhuttukal in the Unicode Registry.

rationale: C1 mentions Tamil Virtual Academy working on Unicode inclusion of Tamil characters, which is a related effort. No extract shows legislation or a legal measure for a standardised Tamil script format in media.

The extracts cover industrial tribunal rules, a rural scheme committee, GST tribunals, an economic census committee and senior citizen tribunals. None concerns a joint committee of association secretaries, department heads and a State Administrative Tribunal.

cited.quote: the 12 cogeneration projects with a capacity of 183 MW approved for implementation by the Tamil Nadu Generation

rationale: C3 (policy note) reports cogeneration projects at sugar mills approved and some commissioned, with no new order or date. C1 is an ethanol policy GO, not electricity. Policy note mentions and ongoing activity give not_started for a directional commitment.

cited.quote: modernization of water treatment plants in the co- generation units of these sugar mills has increased turbine operating efficiency

rationale: C3 and C4 only mention cogeneration within policy notes. C1 and C5 are cane incentives for farmers and C2 is an ethanol policy. No scheme or incentive package for sugar factories producing electricity is shown.

cited.quote: Students who studied in Government Schools and have qualified in the NEET-UG examination were awarded a 7.5% reservation

rationale: C1, C2 and C3 show a 7.5% preferential reservation for government school students in medical admissions, a different group and quota. No extract shows a separate 2.5% reservation for government aided school students.
